client_providers.label: Meta Lead Ads (optional source)
clientProvides: Business-owned Meta app/page access, lead-form ID, webhook subscription, privacy notice, vendor docs
client_providers.secretDestination: Meta token in n8n Credentials; never paste it in this form.
steps: Test with a synthetic or approved sandbox lead.

client_providers.label: WhatsApp Business (optional channel)
client_providers.purpose: Receives consented inbound messages and optionally routes an approved reply draft.
clientProvides: WhatsApp Business/provider account, sender/phone-number ID, approved templates, messaging opt-in
client_providers.secretDestination: Client provider/API credential stored in n8n Credentials.
steps: Connect the provider webhook and credential.
Keep outbound reply nodes inactive pending opt-in and staff approval.

client_providers.label: Property inventory + broker roster
client_providers.purpose: Checks supplied property facts and prepares a human-owned broker/viewing request.
clientProvides: Inventory/CRM API docs or approved Sheets table IDs/columns, broker/area mapping, time slots source
client_providers.secretDestination: Use least-privilege service credential in n8n Credentials.
steps: Map the read-only property lookup and broker rules.
Have staff approve every booking before write/send.

client_providers.label: Voice/notifications (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Accepts a configured provider call payload and alerts the assigned broker.
clientProvides: Provider (e.g. VAPI/Twilio or client choice), callback/webhook docs, notification destination and transfer owner
client_providers.secretDestination: Provider tokens in n8n Credentials; all usage billed to client account.
steps: Confirm provider KYC, permissions, and human-transfer target.
Exercise a synthetic call and error/handoff case.
